topic: Released 0.45.0: password field focused on open (one-shot retry on first window event)

topic: Released 0.46.0: nix update check parallel + git ls-remote for github refs (~1 s on host), same proof rule
content: Today: old check = sequential nix flake metadata per unique ref (fetch+eval, channel tarballs heavy); new = alias resolution via registry, parallel bounded 4, git ls-remote for github targets with rev pins, narHash fallback; list_nix_updates user-scoped; measured 1.39/0.95 s, 14 updates; tag v0.46.0 CI green (pin cb46c1e), host 0.46.0.
